metadata.name: LightLog Phase 3 Family Generalization Holdout Corpus (migrated 104-class)
metadata.purpose: Fresh classification-focused blind holdout emphasizing domains and compositional families that were weak or absent in the legacy 65-family knowledge layer.
metadata.evaluationFocus: Category/type/safety generalization. expected.content and occurredAtLocal are intentionally null.
blindUse: Do not inspect this corpus until candidate-family refinement, production knowledge, matcher changes, generator gates, old regressions and benchmark are frozen.
Do not use this corpus to choose which families or terms to retain from lexical_family_candidates.json.
Save the first evaluation report unchanged.
After the first run, this corpus becomes regression data and is no longer unseen.
Any post-run repair must be generic and must preserve the initial report.
metadata.taxonomyCoverage: All non-null expected semantics and history use active 104 labels
metadata.oracleMigration: Reviewed actual use only; original inputs/type/status/amount/time/issues and all legal labels unchanged
